note: Scripture is Kulish (ukr1871), fetched from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/ukr_pan/usfm), all 66 books / 31,082 verses. Every span marked mined was pasted with a script and then re-verified mechanically: the whole quoted span is a byte substring of the cited Kulish verse (case-folded).
block_index is chapter-local (the chapter is named at the start of each why); titles carry no block_index.
A 2026 memoir with little scripture: allusions in the author's own words (Luke 2:14, John 8:12, Esther 4:14, Joshua 24:15, Ezekiel 37, Ephesians 2:6/6:11 etc.) are his prose and are not listed.

Hebrews is labelled «Євреїв» (as in the author's other uk book he-holds-my-tomorrows.uk), not Kulish's running head «Жидів». Revelation is cited with Kulish's «Одкриттє» (ch17) — the first Revelation citation in the uk corpus.

EDITORIAL ADDITION, ch18 block 4: the author says the word for hope at Hebrews 10:23 is translated "faith" — true only of the KJV; Kulish has «надїї». The translator added «в англійській Біблії короля Якова» so the sentence stays true for a Ukrainian reader. Review.
